factory_info.layout_description: A parallel production line laid out along the sequence Machining -> Assembly -> Raw Material Intake -> Surface Treatment -> Packaging -> Quality Inspection, with stations grouped by workflow step.

parallel_groups.reasoning: Steps Machining, Assembly do not share equipment or line dependencies, so they can run concurrently without blocking one another.
